# apple_game_center_challenge_localization (Resource)

Sets the name and description of a Game Center challenge for one locale; `apple_game_center_challenge_image` adds the locale's image. Changes go to the version being prepared; when the current version has been reviewed, applying starts the next one. Changes fail while a version is in review. Destroying the resource deletes the localization from the version being prepared, and otherwise leaves it. Import it with `<challenge_id>/<locale>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_game_center_challenge_localization" "en_US" {
  challenge_id = apple_game_center_challenge.example.id
  locale       = "en-US"
  name         = "Weekly Duel"
  description  = "Beat your friends this week."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `challenge_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the challenge, e.g. `apple_game_center_challenge.example.id`.
- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`.
- `name` (String) Name of the challenge.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the challenge.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the localization, which changes with each version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_challenge_localization.en_US
  identity = {
    challenge_id = "1d3f5a7c-9b2e-4c6d-8a0f-2b4c6d8e0f1a"
    locale       = "en-US"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `challenge_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the challenge, e.g. `apple_game_center_challenge.example.id`.
- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_game_center_challenge_localization.en_US 1d3f5a7c-9b2e-4c6d-8a0f-2b4c6d8e0f1a/en-US
```
